per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be easy to use, requiring minimal training for users to book rooms and check equipment availability.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to use. 90% of users will be able to successfully reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide clear and reliable search results, including accurate availability and equipment filters.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall allow for intuitive searching of available conference rooms.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide clear confirmation feedback to users after completing actions, such as booking a room.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should integrate with various email servers to reliably send invites and reminders.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with various email servers. The product shall be able to send email.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond quickly to user actions, with basic tasks completing in under five seconds and most tasks in under ten seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be available with very high uptime, approaching 99.99% availability.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should comply with ADA standards for accessibility, including support for screen readers, keyboard navigation, and high-contrast themes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall conform to the Americans with Disabilities Act.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support multiple languages and display dates and times in formats appropriate for the user's locale.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be tested on a minimum of eight different browsers and versions, with at least 80% of them rendering correctly.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide clear and actionable error messages that explain what went wrong and suggest next steps.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have a user-friendly interface that does not feel like an admin tool.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to use. 90% of users will be able to successfully reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support mobile access for users.
